question: An effect gives Village Ironsmith +2/+2 until end of turn, and then it transforms into Ironfang. Does Ironfang keep the +2/+2 until end of turn?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: Ironfang continues to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
expected.answer: An effect gives Village Ironsmith (the front face of a double-faced card) +2/+2 until end of turn and then Village Ironsmith transforms into Ironfang. Ironfang will continue to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
